description: Session 6 per-destination net recurrent-current decomposition, split by TT/TR/RT/RR and recurrent-weight sign after excluding reset t=0 frames.
notes: Every selected frame computes the instantaneous recurrent product g_ij(t) * W_ij * h_j(t-1), rather than multiplying separately averaged gate and activity terms.
TT/TR/RT/RR are digit-context-specific and each positive/negative/total contribution is divided by its destination-unit count.
The gate component uses the equal-weight cross-digit mean gate while retaining actual h_j(t-1); it is not a frozen-gate counterfactual.
Supplementary 4 renders the digit-wise ΔI and gate-only contributions with seed mean ± SEM.
The first attempt wrote no units because its one-digit seed path omitted leading zeros; recovery r2 uses a new result leaf and explicit two-digit paths.
